name: Tadeusz Franciszek Władysław Miączyński

events.note: Repurchased the estate sold in 1892 to Countess Maria Wielopolska, bringing it back to the Miączyńskis. The town history sign at Trąbczyn gives this; the act of the purchase has not been found.

events.type: Owner of Trąbczyn when Włodzimierów was parcelled from it
events.note: Breyer, in July 1936, has Włodzimierów parcelled from the Trąbczyn estate "25 years ago", the owner "Graf Miączyński"; no forename is given.

notes: Son of Witold Miączyński, grandson of Michalina née Prusimska, first cousin of Władysław Miączyński, who had sold Trąbczyn in 1892.
The database gives his wife as Maria hr. Miączyńska (1862-1919) but names his own parents as hers; who his wife was is not settled.
